CurrencyTypeStep.query:
q = load "CurrencyType"; q = filter q by 'CurrencyCode' in ["{{coalesce(cell(ForecastingUserPreference.result, 0, "ForecastingViewCurrency"), "DefaultCurrency").asString()}}"] || 'IsCorporate' == "true"; q = foreach q generate 'NewConversionRate' as 'ConversionRate', 'CurrencyCode' as 'IsoCode', 'IsCorporate';q = order q by 'IsCorporate' asc;
q = limit q 2;

QuotaAchieved.label: QuotaAchieved
QuotaAchieved.query: a = load "User"; a = foreach a generate case when ("{{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "IsQuotaAvailable").asString() }}" == "QuotaAvailable" and {{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "PercentQuotaAchieved").asString() }} <= 49) then "#D14062" when ("{{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "IsQuotaAvailable").asString() }}" == "QuotaAvailable" and {{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "PercentQuotaAchieved").asString() }} >= 50 and {{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "PercentQuotaAchieved").asString() }} <= 99) then "#F9A549" else "#0BA976" end as 'color', case when "{{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "IsQuotaAvailable").asString() }}" == "NoQuota" then "" else "Quota Attainment" end as 'QuotaSubText', case when "{{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "IsQuotaAvailable").asString() }}" == "NoQuota" then "" else "{{ cell(QuotaDetermination.result, 0, "PercentQuotaAchieved").asString() }}%" end as 'PercentQuotaAchieved';

QuotaDetermination.label: QuotaDetermination
QuotaDetermination.query: b = load "ForecastingData";b = filter b by 'Type' == "Quota" && 'Category' == "Quota" && 'Owner_ID' == "!{user.Id}"&& 'Period_ID' == "{{cell(CurrentPeriod.result, 0, "Id").asString()}}"; c = load "User"; c = filter c by 'Id' == "!{user.Id}"; d = group c by 'Id' left, b by 'Owner_ID'; d = foreach d generate first(c.'FullPhotoUrl') as 'ChatterImage', case when sum(b.'Value') is not null then "QuotaAvailable" else "NoQuota" end as 'IsQuotaAvailable', coalesce(round({{coalesce(cell(ForecastingClosedItem.result, 0, "AmountWithoutManagerAdjustment"), 0).asObject()}} / ( sum(b.'Value') * {{coalesce(cell(CurrencyTypeStep.result, 0, "ConversionRate"), 1).asObject()}}) * 100, 1), 0) as 'PercentQuotaAchieved'; d = limit d 2000;

ForecastingPrediction.label: ForecastingPrediction
ForecastingPrediction.query:
q = load "ForecastingData";q = filter q by 'Type' == "Prediction" && 'Category' == "Prediction" && 'Owner_ID' == "!{user.Id}" && 'Period_ID' == "{{cell(CurrentPeriod.result, 0, "Id").asString()}}";
q = foreach q generate 'Owner_ID' as 'OwnerId', 'Value' * {{coalesce(cell(CurrencyTypeStep.result, 0, "ConversionRate"), 1).asObject()}} as 'Amount';

UserData.query: q = load "User"; q = filter q by 'Id' == "!{user.Id}"; q = foreach q generate q.'FirstName' as 'FirstName', q.'Name' as 'Name', q.'Id' as 'Id', q.'Username' as 'Username', q.'DefaultCurrencyIsoCode' as 'DefaultCurrencyIsoCode';

ForecastingClosedItem.label: ForecastingClosedItem
ForecastingClosedItem.query:
q = load "ForecastingData";q = filter q by 'Type' == "AmountWithoutManagerAdjustment" && 'Category' == "ClosedOnly" && 'Owner_ID' == "!{user.Id}" && 'Period_ID' == "{{cell(CurrentPeriod.result, 0, "Id").asString()}}";
q = foreach q generate 'Owner_ID' as 'OwnerId', 'Value' * {{coalesce(cell(CurrencyTypeStep.result, 0, "ConversionRate"), 1).asObject()}} as 'AmountWithoutManagerAdjustment', 'Date' as 'Date'; q = order q by 'Date' desc; q = limit q 1;

TrendingPerformanceChartStep.query: q = load "ForecastingData";q = filter q by 'Type' in ["AmountWithoutManagerAdjustment", "Actual", "Predicted" ] && 'Category' in ["Predicted", "Actual", "CommitForecast", "BestCaseForecast" ] && 'Owner_ID' == "!{user.Id}" && 'Period_ID' == "{{cell(CurrentPeriod.result, 0, "Id").asString()}}";q = group q by ('Date_Year', 'Date_Month', 'Date_Day', 'Category');q = foreach q generate ((('Date_Year' + "~~~") + 'Date_Month') + "~~~") + 'Date_Day' as 'Date_Year~~~Date_Month~~~Date_Day', 'Category' as 'Category', sum('Value') * {{coalesce(cell(CurrencyTypeStep.result, 0, "ConversionRate"), 1).asObject()}} as 'Amount', "{{coalesce(cell(CurrencyTypeStep.result, 0, "IsoCode"), "DefaultCurrency").asString()}}" as 'Currency', case when 'Category' == "Predicted" then sum('ValueHigherBound') * {{coalesce(cell(CurrencyTypeStep.result, 0, "ConversionRate"), 1).asObject()}} end as 'Upper Bound', case when 'Category' == "Predicted" then sum('ValueLowerBound') * {{coalesce(cell(CurrencyTypeStep.result, 0, "ConversionRate"), 1).asObject()}} end as 'Lower Bound';q = order q by ('Date_Year~~~Date_Month~~~Date_Day' desc, 'Category' desc);q = limit q 100;
